apps.title: GPS Route Viewer
apps.description: See where you went each day on a map, from the Overland iOS app's GPS logs: trips, stops, distance and speed. It runs in Docker on your own Raspberry Pi 5 or x86_64 Linux server, so your location history stays there.

ai.label: No AI
ai.source: somaari-trip README: "No accounts, no API keys, no third-party services."

apps.title: Disk Usage Analyzer
apps.description: See what is using space on your drives, largest items first. Read-only and fully offline, for Linux (Raspberry Pi OS, Debian, Ubuntu and more) and Windows 10/11.

ai.label: No AI
ai.source: somaari-disk README: "The app makes no network requests"; no AI dependencies.

apps.title: Task Planner
apps.description: A small planner that runs on your own Raspberry Pi or other Linux machine. Turn Markdown plans, pasted notes or a quick line into dated tasks, with Today, calendar and board views. AI is optional: with it off, nothing leaves your Pi.

ai.label: AI optional
ai.source: somaari-plan README: "AI optional ... mode = \"off\" works with no AI at all."

apps.title: AI-assisted Terminal
apps.description: A smart terminal for the Raspberry Pi 5 and other Debian-based Linux with an X11 desktop: type commands or just say what you want in plain English. Local-first, and every AI-suggested command passes a safety check before it runs.

label: AI-powered
AI optional
ai.source: somaari-terminal README: "Every AI key is optional." AI is its main feature.
